_note: FICTIONAL clinic for a training exercise. Every name, address, phone number and price in services/data is invented.
name: Zaytoun Family Clinic

rules: Appointments can be booked up to 21 days ahead.
A booking can be cancelled up to 24 hours before it starts. Later than that, the patient must call the clinic.
New patients should arrive 10 minutes early.
A patient under 16 needs a parent or guardian: the booking must include the guardian's name. Every pediatrics visit counts as a patient under 16.
One patient (phone number) can hold at most 3 upcoming appointments.
The receptionist never gives medical advice or a diagnosis. It can only book a visit with a clinician.
Emergencies: call 101 or go to the nearest emergency department.

emergency_message: If this is an emergency, call 101 or go to the nearest emergency department now.

faq.a: The clinic has no private parking. There is public street parking on Olive Grove Street (fictional).
Cash or card at the reception desk. Prices are in ILS and are for information only.
Step-free entrance and a lift to the first floor.
Reception speaks Arabic and English. Each provider's languages are listed with the provider.
